Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier. We'd like to schedule a product demo that includes stakeholders across the US, EU and APAC teams. High-level constraints:
- US: David (VP Eng) prefers mornings PT (08:00–11:00 PT)
- EU: I (CE) and two PMs are available in the afternoon CEST (14:00–17:00 CEST)
- APAC: our Singapore office can do late afternoons SGT (16:00–18:30 SGT)

I know daylight savings and conversions have tripped us before — can you propose 2–3 slots that work for Redwood and confirm what time zone you put on the calendar invite? Our CEO would like the invite in UTC to avoid confusion.

Attached is a quick sheet of our preferred times by region. Ideally we'd do a 45-min demo + 15-min Q&A and have a 15-min tech-check 30 mins ahead for the SE.

Thanks,
Amelia Turner

Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood inference — multi-region scheduling (US / EU / APAC)

Hi Amelia — great to hear and thanks for the constraints. Looping in Jonas (SE) and Vivek (who will join for the executive portion).

Two candidate slots that align to the windows you shared (all times shown with the primary attendee timezone in parentheses):

Option A — 2026-05-12 09:00 PT / 16:00 CEST / 23:00 SGT (45 + 15)
Option B — 2026-05-13 08:30 PT / 15:30 CEST / 22:30 SGT (45 + 15)

Both are within David's morning window and your EU afternoon. Option A is a little late for APAC but within their 16:00–18:30 SGT range. We can also flip to an earlier APAC-friendly slot, but that would push the US to very early morning.

We will put the calendar invite in UTC (as requested) and include the local time labels; I will explicitly set the Google Calendar event timezone to UTC to avoid DST ambiguity. We will also add a 15-min tech-check for Jonas 30 minutes before the demo.

I've attached a quick Redwood time-matrix with the UTC conversions for the two options to make it easier for your team. Can you confirm which option you prefer and whether the CEO can make Option A?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood inference — multi-region scheduling (US / EU / APAC)

Quick note from the SE side:
- I can do either Option A or B.
- Please confirm whether you want the demo recorded and whether there are any corp policy restrictions on recordings in APAC.
- Tech-check plan: 15 min before the demo (we'll test screen-share, Zoom permissions, and any SSO/proxy tunneling). If you prefer, we can do the tech check with just the hosts and open the line for participants 5 min before the start.

Small gotcha we've seen: when invites are created in local timezones, Google sometimes shows the event in the participant's local timezone correctly, but exported ICS files can still carry the original timezone tag. Setting the event timezone explicitly to UTC and adding the local time in the description is the safest route.

I'll prep a short demo agenda and send it as a PDF once we lock time.

- Jonas
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
